subject: Communication English
chapters: Use of Visual Aids in Communication

questions.text: Prepare a report of a case study of a cybersecurity breach and its consequences. Write abstract, finding and discussion parts only.
You are the project leader for a team of 20 members. As the team members are not submitting the weekly time sheets regularly, write an e-mail to them stressing the need to submit without fail.

questions.chapter: Use of Visual Aids in Communication
questions.text: Create a bar graph (Gantt chart) to show the work schedule of any proposed technical project.
Prepare a reference page of the given publication details according to the APA (American Psychological Association) style of citation.
Define technical communication, and mention its scope and importance for engineers.
Describe the nature of technical communication and mention core ethics of engineering profession.

Write bias-free (gender-neutral) words of the following: Career girl, mailman, freshman, front man, working woman, workmanship, masterplan, motherly, brotherhood, manhood, waitress, foreman, alumni, faculty wife, Frenchmen, gentleman's agreement.
What are the tips to make any technical writing coherent and concise? Does avoiding redundancy lead to concise writing?

Every year a huge number of Nepalese lose their lives in road accidents. To minimize the loss of lives you want to do a study. Write a brief proposal to an organization incorporating title page, abstract and introduction parts.

Prepare a proposal for construction of a public library building in your local town to be submitted to the Mayor of the concerned municipality. Show only the title page, abstract and cost estimate sections of the proposal.

As a Personnel Manager of Dynamics Tools Manufacturing Co. Ltd, Teku, Kathmandu, you have been deputed to investigate the causes of frequent strikes in the company's factory at Ring Road and to suggest preventive measures. Write only cover page, preface, and recommendations parts of your report.
Write a job application for the post of an IT officer in XYZ Software Company, Baneshwor, Kathmandu. Also, create a resume to be attached with it.

Prepare a complaint letter to be sent to the head office of your organization's internet service provider and express your dissatisfaction of poor internet connection despite using their most premium package.
As a secretary of your local social club, write a notice with four-point agenda for the third monthly meeting of the club. Base the agenda on the upcoming election of the club.
Write a short note on barriers of active listening and how to overcome them.
What do you mean by non-verbal communication? Describe its elements in brief.
